title: The tellers
status: complete scene draft for review; dialogue, casting and polis design provisional
scope: Start on the storyteller after the factory cut. End with the older resident's first reply. No Hall visit or explanation of extinction.
direction: A chalk-stone conversation court in an unreal violet-grey polis. Rounded dark graphite puppets, orange-yellow emissive eyes, no mouths. Three different temperaments expressed through held poses, gaze and hands. Comedy gives way to an earnest question.

dialogue.speaker: challenge
dialogue.text: You did finish. There was nobody left.

dialogue.speaker: quiet
dialogue.text: Maybe the timer told the story.

dialogue.speaker: quiet
dialogue.text: Was there really a last one?

dialogue.speaker: quiet
dialogue.text: Just one person. With nobody to talk to?

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: I used to ask that, too.
